text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>, you put so much careful thought into your training menus.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...I must push harder too! I have to refine our training to the absolute limit for Meek's sake!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: As peers of the same class, let's continue spurring each other on!
